main_text.head: Hydropicus potans. XIIII.
main_text.p: INiuste partis opibus si forte beatos Putas auaros, falleris. Epotis auidè lymphis quis posse〜 beari Hydropicos existimet ?

page.notes: The woodcut shows a seated man drinking from a vessel in an interior with a door and window; a jug stands at right. The initial I is a large woodcut letter. The verse line "posse〜 beari" has a tilde-like mark over the e in printed form; read as printed. The heading number "XIIII." is printed as XIIII.
